state.rule: OperationalProcessNameClaim holds one normalized process name per tenant for at most one process stream, tagged with a change generation. The holder may re-pin at an equal or later generation; a different process is refused; an earlier generation is refused; a release only works for the exact holder and generation. Exact authorized retries resolve the original accepted result; changed intent is a permanent conflict.

code_behavior.retry: When the hydration was selected for a logical id and that id already produced a fact, a command with that logical id succeeds with no new fact only if the fact type, full operation binding (including command kind), holder, revision, generation and intent all match; otherwise it returns Conflict. This holds even if later facts changed the holder.
code_behavior.command_kind: Claim and Release do not check that operation.CommandKind is the claim or release command kind of this owner. A Claim called with a Release-kind operation and a new logical id would raise a Claimed fact. The kind is bound only through AcceptedOperationBinding on retries; handlers choose the kind.
code_behavior.test_retry_after_release: Test: claim at generation 1, then release, history replayed into a fresh claim selected for the claim's logical id. The same claim command is retried. Expected: success, no new fact, name stays free.
code_behavior.test_changed: Test: after an accepted claim with logical id L, the same L is retried with a changed digest, intent, generation, revision, holder or as a release; each returns Conflict, still exactly one fact and the holder unchanged.

retry_test_asserts_invariant.instructions: The test in `state.code_behavior.test_retry_after_release` proves that an exact retry of an already committed claim is acknowledged without raising a second fact and without re-taking a name that was released.

criteria.true: It would fail if the retry raised a new fact or re-held the name.
criteria.false: It can pass even if the retry raised a new claim fact or re-held the name.

changed_test_asserts_rule.instructions: The test in `state.code_behavior.test_changed` proves the rule that changed intent for an accepted logical id is a permanent conflict without a new fact.

criteria.true: Each changed field produces Conflict and the single fact and holder remain, so the rule is proven.
criteria.false: The test can pass while a changed retry is accepted or appends a fact.

retry_consistent.instructions: The `state.code_behavior.retry` behavior is consistent with the rule text about exact authorized retries and changed intent.

command_kind_gap.instructions: State code_behavior.command_kind is an owner decision the model is silent on. What is the right disposition for the aggregate stage?

criteria.add_to_model: The aggregate must reject operations whose command kind is not its own claim or release kind.
criteria.handler_concern: Command kind selection and validation belong to the handler or receiver that builds the operation; the aggregate need not check it.
criteria.needs_source_resolution: The sources must be consulted before deciding.

command_kind_premise.instructions: Premise: the model text is silent on whether the aggregate must validate the command kind, and the code does not validate it, so the gap exists.

criteria.true: The model is silent and the code does not validate, so the gap is real.
